learning: Use regularized low-capacity shared transport and local-transition regressors first. Share parameters across instances; separate material-type heads allowed. Fit one-step labels, select regularization by whole-configuration autonomous rollout, then freeze. Compare a matched additive transport baseline with the same local-transition capacity. Do not call this a DNN or whole-scene ignition classifier.
anti_leakage: No FDS values during autonomous inference; previous emissions/states must be model predictions.
Do not split timesteps across train/validation.
Never use held-out FDS outcomes for parameter selection.
Freeze model, exact scene inputs and graph/additive predictions before test simulation results are accessed.
limits: 16 development cases support only a constrained exploratory fit; correlated time samples are not independent simulations.
P95 temperature captures a hot tail imperfectly; aggregation may lose the hot-zone location needed for transfer.
Wood thermal memory must be modeled; surface temperature alone may be insufficient.
Training must include roof/other facade orientations or explicitly report those held-out receivers as out of support.
Any state clipping is numerical stabilization, not proof of conservation.
